entities.description: A close-up view of a child riding a black bicycle on a dirt surface, showing the front wheel, handlebars, and the rider's legs and feet. The bicycle has a simple frame with a visible chain guard and a front fender, and the rider is wearing a pink top, a patterned skirt, and brown sandals.

rider.pose: riding, with one foot on the pedal and the other on the ground

environment.surface: dirt, with visible texture and small rocks

entities.description: A large, coarse burlap sack is being carried on the shoulders of a young boy, appearing full and heavy with a light tan, woven texture. The sack is positioned horizontally across the upper back, with the boy's hands gripping the fabric on either side to secure it.

A young Black boy with short hair is running forward on a dirt path, carrying a large, flat, light-brown object on his shoulders. He is wearing a bright yellow polo shirt with a dark collar, dark blue shorts, and brown slip-on shoes, and he has a wide, joyful smile on his face.

A smiling young Black girl with an orange headscarf rides a black bicycle, wearing a bright pink t-shirt and a colorful patterned skirt. She is positioned in the center of the frame, facing forward with a joyful expression, against a blurred background of dry, reddish-brown earth and distant trees.

attributes.pose: sitting on bicycle, hands on handlebars

accessories.bicycle: black frame, silver handlebars, black tires

attributes.background: dry, arid landscape with reddish soil and sparse trees
